title: Lakehouse: MinIO policies + users (mc admin)
description: Runs `nexus acl lakehouse list`. Lists the MinIO policies and users via the on-node `mc admin policy ls` + `mc admin user ls`. The MinIO root + the nexus-lakehouse-app service identity are flagged protected.

observe.what: the MinIO policies (readwrite/readonly/consoleAdmin/...) + the service users; nexus-lakehouse-app flagged protected

whatProves: LakehouseAdapter.AclAsync lists MinIO policies + users through the on-node mc nexuslocal alias; the root + app identities are revoke-protected.
